_doc: Task 6D section 16. WHU pseudo-instance error classification for the free-generation validation records. Flags are derived from the GT component map (the WHU polygon components) and the GT mask, never from a prediction.

whu_limitation_judgement.reason: NOT attributable to the dataset: the model emitted essentially one constant mask, so all 116/120 records fail regardless of their content. The flag distribution (`tiny_target` at 93% of failures) describes the failure population, not a dataset defect, and this evidence does not indicate a dataset-selection task.

note: The dataset is not changed in Task 6D (section 1).
